summary: A new Get Started guide walks a new environment through setup, and drift mails are less frequent.

new.title: Get Started guides new environments
new.text: A new Get Started menu walks you through every setup step, marks each done or open, and opens the page that does the work. A red ! shows while a required step is open.

new.title: Choose how often the drift mail comes
new.text: The "Configuration drift detected" mail now goes out every two weeks by default. You can change it in Settings under Alerting.

fixes.title: Clearer administrative unit errors
fixes.text: A role at an administrative unit whose group, unit or role cannot be found is now explained, with the fix.

fixes.title: Licence alerts reach Invardia
fixes.text: The MSP licence check now reports to Invardia in a form it accepts.
